mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_behavior_outbox WHERE state<>'SENT' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM tb_behavior_failure ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_behavior_outbox SET state='PENDING',attempts=0,next_attempt_at=NOW(3),lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND state='REVIEW'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_shop_heat_bucket(shop_id,bucket_ms,visits,orders,payments) VALUES(#{shopId},#{bucketMs},#{visits},#{orders},#{payments}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visits=visits+VALUES(visits),orders=orders+VALUES(orders),payments=payments+VALUES(payments)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_behavior_outbox WHERE (state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=NOW(3)) OR (state='SENDING' AND lease_until<NOW(3)) ORDER BY created_at,event_id LIMIT 10 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_behavior_outbox SET state='PENDING',next_attempt_at=NOW(3),sent_at=NULL WHERE state='SENT' AND sent_at<TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,-5,NOW(3)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_behavior_event e WHERE e.event_id=tb_behavior_outbox.event_id) LIMIT 200
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_behavior_outbox WHERE state IN ('PENDING','SENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_behavior_outbox WHERE state='REVIEW'
